source.note: Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets (master) + allStat_gen skillParam. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Levels: Lv10, except constellation-boosted talents of 4-star characters at Lv13 (C6 assumed). Normal/charged/plunging default to physical unless the sheet overrides the element (infusions are NOT applied).

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: C1 Excellent Blood: the CRIT Rate of Kaeya's Normal and Charged Attacks against opponents affected by Cryo is increased by 15%.

auto.name: Ceremonial Bladework
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Frostgnaw
skill.desc: Unleashes a frigid blast, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in front of Kaeya. Kaeya seems affable, but his nature is that of unyielding ice.

burst.name: Glacial Waltz
burst.desc: Coalescing the frost in the air, Kaeya summons 3 icicles that revolve around him. These icicles will follow the character around and deal Cryo DMG to opponents in their path for the ability's duration. A winsome smile, genial words, and the merciless hoarfrost that lies beneath... These are all Kaeya's weapons.

passives.name: Cold-Blooded Strike
passives.desc: Every hit with <k>Frostgnaw</k> regenerates HP for Kaeya equal to 15% of his ATK.

passives.name: Glacial Heart
passives.desc:
Opponents <e:cryo>Frozen</e> by <k>Frostgnaw</k> will drop additional Elemental Particles.
Frostgnaw may only produce a maximum of 2 additional Elemental Particles per use.

passives.name: Hidden Strength
passives.desc:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

constellations.name: Excellent Blood
constellations.desc: The CRIT Rate of Kaeya's Normal and Charge Attacks against opponents affected by <e:cryo>Cryo</e> is increased by 15%.

constellations.name: Never-Ending Performance
constellations.desc: While <k>Glacial Waltz</k> is in effect, for each opponent defeated, its duration is increased by 2.5s, up to a maximum of 15s.

constellations.name: Dance of Frost
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Frostgnaw</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Frozen Kiss
constellations.desc:
Triggers automatically when Kaeya's HP falls below 20%:
Creates a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of Kaeya's Max HP. Lasts for 20s.
This shield absorbs <e:cryo>Cryo DMG</e> with 250% efficiency.
Can only occur once every 60s.

constellations.name: Frostbiting Embrace
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Glacial Waltz</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Glacial Whirlwind
constellations.desc: <k>Glacial Waltz</k> will generate 1 additional icicle, and will regenerate 15 Energy when cast.

auto.name: Passe d'armes
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Enchaîne jusqu'à 5 coups d'épée.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance pour déclencher deux coups d'épée rapides.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs pour frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des DGT de zone à l'impact.

skill.name: Attaque givrée
skill.desc: Libère un blizzard gelant qui inflige des DGT Cryo aux ennemis en face. Qui serait capable de faire fondre la glace qui se cache derrière ce masque aimable...

burst.name: Valse glaciale
burst.desc: Kaeya condense les particules dans l'air pour invoquer 3 stalactites tournoyantes. Les stalactites suivent le personnage, et infligent des DGT Cryo aux ennemis sur leur route. Ses dehors souriants, son ton agréable, et la glace qu'ils cachent : voici les armes de Kaeya.

passives.name: Épée de la cruauté
passives.desc: Chaque fois qu'<k>Attaque givrée</k> touche un ennemi, Kaeya récupère une quantité de PV équivalant à 15 % de son ATQ.

passives.name: Cœur de l'Abîme glacial
passives.desc:
Les ennemis <e:cryo>gelés</e> par <k>Attaque givrée</k> font tomber davantage de particules élémentaires.
Attaque givrée peut accorder un maximum de 2 particules supplémentaires de cette manière à chaque utilisation.

passives.name: Force cachée
passives.desc:
Diminue la consommation d'endurance de vos personnages dans l'équipe de 20 % lors du sprint.
Ne peut pas être cumulé avec d'autres aptitudes passives aux effets identiques.

constellations.name: Lignée de l'excellence
constellations.desc: Le taux CRIT des attaques normales et chargées de Kaeya contre les ennemis affectés par l'<e:cryo>élément Cryo</e> augmente de 15 %.

constellations.name: Danse givrée éternelle
constellations.desc: Chaque ennemi éliminé pendant la durée de <k>Valse glaciale</k> prolonge la durée de la compétence de 2,5 s. Cumul maximum : 15 s.

constellations.name: Ébats glacials
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Attaque givrée</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Baiser glacé
constellations.desc:
Kaeya génère un bouclier lorsque ses PV sont inférieurs à 20 %.
Le bouclier absorbe une quantité de DGT équivalant à 30 % des PV max et dure 20 s.
Le bouclier est efficace à 250 % contre les <e:cryo>DGT Cryo</e>.
Cet effet peut être déclenché une fois toutes les 60 s.

constellations.name: Étreinte glaciale
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Valse glaciale</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Tourbillon glacial
constellations.desc: Génère une stalactite supplémentaire pendant <k>Valse glaciale</k> et restaure 15 pts d'énergie élémentaire.

auto.name: Lâmina Cerimonial
auto.desc:
<k>Ataque Normal</k>
Realiza até 5 golpes rápidos.

<k>Ataque Carregado</k>
Consome uma certa quantidade de Stamina para desferir 2 golpes rápidos com a espada.

<k>Ataque Imersivo</k>
Mergulha em pleno ar para golpear o chão, causando dano aos inimigos ao longo do caminho e infligindo Dano em uma AdE durante o impacto.

skill.name: Mordida Congelante
skill.desc: Lança uma explosão gélida, infligindo Dano Cryo aos inimigos em frente ao Kaeya. Kaeya parece afável, mas sua natureza é a do gelo inflexível.

burst.name: Valsa Glacial
burst.desc: Coalescendo a geada no ar, Kaeya invoca 3 pontas de gelo que giram em torno dele. Esses pingentes seguirão o personagem e causarão Dano Cryo aos inimigos em seu caminho enquanto eles persistirem. Um sorriso encantador, palavras gentis e a geada implacável que se esconde... Essas são todas as armas de Kaeya.

passives.name: Espada do Sangue Frio
passives.desc: Cada golpe com <k>Mordida Congelante</k> regenera a Vida de Kaeya equivalente a 15% do seu ATQ.

passives.name: Coração Glacial
passives.desc:
Os inimigos <k>Congelados</k> pela <e:cryo>Mordida Congelante</e> irão dropar Partículas Elementais adicionais.
A Mordida Congelante pode produzir no máximo 2 Partículas Elementais por uso.

passives.name: Força Oculta
passives.desc:
Diminui o consumo de Stamina ao Correr de todos os seus personagens em 20%.
Não acumulável com Talentos Passivos que concedem exatamente os mesmos efeitos.

constellations.name: Sangue Excelente
constellations.desc: A Taxa Crítica do Ataque Normal e Ataque Carregado de Kaeya contra os inimigos afetados por <e:cryo>Cryo</e> aumentam em 15%.

constellations.name: Apresentação Eterna
constellations.desc: Cada <k>Valsa Glacial</k> que derrotar um inimigo aumenta sua duração em 2.5s por 15s.

constellations.name: Dança do Gelo
constellations.desc:
Aumenta o nível do <k>Mordida Congelante</k> em 3.
O nível máximo de elevação é 15.

constellations.name: Beijo Congelante
constellations.desc:
Ativa automaticamente quando a Vida de Kaeya cai para menos de 20%.
Cria um escudo que absorve Dano igual a 30% da Vida Máxima de Kaeya. Dura 20 segundos.
Esse escudo absorve 250% do <e:cryo>Dano Cryo</e> mais eficientemente. Pode ocorrer apenas uma vez a cada 60 segundos.

constellations.name: Abraço Congelante
constellations.desc:
Aumenta o nível do <k>Valsa Glacial</k> em 3.
O nível máximo de elevação é 15.

constellations.name: Redemoinho Glacial
constellations.desc: A <k>Valsa Glacial</k> irá gerar 1 Ponta de Gelo adicional, e irá retornar 15 de Energia quando lançada.

auto.name: 仪典剑术
auto.desc:
<k>普通攻击</k>
进行至多五段的连续剑击。

<k>重击</k>
消耗一定体力，瞬间向前方挥出两剑。

<k>下落攻击</k>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。

skill.name: 霜袭
skill.desc: 瞬间放出急冻的寒气，对前方的敌人造成冰元素伤害。 看上去如此亲切的凯亚，是谁也无法融化的坚冰。

burst.name: 凛冽轮舞
burst.desc: 凝聚空气中的寒霜，召唤3枚围绕自身旋转的寒冰之棱。 存在期间内，寒冰之棱会跟随角色运动，对路径上的敌人造成冰元素伤害。 亲切的笑容、和善的话语，和潜藏在这两者之下的毫不留情的冰霜，都是凯亚的武器。

passives.name: 冷血之剑
passives.desc: <k>霜袭</k>每击中一个单位，便为凯亚恢复等同于攻击力15%的生命值。

passives.name: 冰渊之心
passives.desc:
<k>霜袭</k>使敌人<e:cryo>冻结</e>时，被冻结的敌人会掉落额外的元素微粒。
一次霜袭至多因此产生2个额外元素微粒。

passives.name: 隐藏的实力
passives.desc:
队伍中自己的角色冲刺消耗的体力降低20%。
无法与效果完全相同的固有天赋叠加。

constellations.name: 卓越的血脉
constellations.desc: 对受到<e:cryo>冰元素</e>影响的敌人，凯亚的普通攻击与重击暴击率提升15%。

constellations.name: 无尽的霜舞
constellations.desc: 在<k>凛冽轮舞</k>的持续时间内击败敌人时，持续时间延长2.5秒，最多不会超过15秒。

constellations.name: 凛冽的冰戏
constellations.desc:
<k>霜袭</k>的技能等级提高3级。
至多提升至15级。

constellations.name: 极寒的轻吻
constellations.desc:
凯亚的生命值低于20%时自动触发：
生成一个伤害吸收量等于生命值上限30%的护盾，持续20秒。
该护盾对<e:cryo>冰元素伤害</e>有250%的吸收效果。
该效果每60秒只能触发一次。

constellations.name: 至冷的拥抱
constellations.desc:
<k>凛冽轮舞</k>的技能等级提高3级。
至多提升至15级。

constellations.name: 轮旋的冰凌
constellations.desc: <k>凛冽轮舞</k>会产生一个额外的寒冰之棱，并在施放时返还15点元素能量。
